label: 1FINITY T310 muxponder blade
description: 1RU 200G muxponder blade for metro and regional aggregation: 20x 10GbE/OTU2/OC-192 client ports multiplexed onto two 100G/200G CFP2-ACO coherent line ports, DC powered and NEBS level 3. Modelled as 20x SFP+ 10G client ports plus 2 line ports at 100G/200G, modelled at this engine's 100G ceiling.
